info.title: RANU Club Management Platform
info.description: RANU Club Management Platform API. Errors always use `{"error": {"code", "message", "details", "request_id"}}`. Lists use `?page=&size=` and return `{items,total,page,size}`. All timestamps are UTC ISO-8601.

schema.title: Response Branches Api V1 Public Branches Get
Response Game Types Api V1 Public Game Types Get
Response Tables Api V1 Public Branches  Branch Id  Tables Get
Response Plans Api V1 Public Membership Plans Get

get.description:
Which tables are free for the requested slot, with a backend-computed price quote.
Unavailable tables include `next_available_at` so customers know when they will be free.

schema.title: Response Availability Api V1 Public Availability Get

get.description: Busy blocks per table for a business day (no customer data) + next free time.

post.description: Checkout step: hold the table (default 10 min) and create the deposit payment order.
DEV/DEMO ONLY (PAYMENT_PROVIDER=mock): simulates the provider webhook.

get.description: Live table grid: status, running session with live bill, next booking, device health.

post.description: Walk-in or booked start (manual). Hardware-triggered starts use the device API.

post.description:
Commissioning / training tool: inject a synthetic signal for a table and see
how the detection engine reacts (identical code path to real hardware).
Send one event or a batch `{"events": [...]}`. Each `event_id` is processed at most once.

event.description: e.g. ACTIVITY_DETECTED, CARD_TAP, GAME_ACTIVITY, NO_ACTIVITY, START_REQUEST

api_key.title: Api Key
api_key.description: Shown once. Store it on the device/gateway.
